newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan 16-megabit DRAM prices start falling - paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan 16-megabit DRAM prices start falling - paper.

text.p: Prices of 16-megabit dynamic random access memory (DRAM) chips for volume users for November shipment fell in Japan following a fall in spot-market prices overseas, a Japanese economic daily said on Friday.
The Nihon Keisai Shimbun said that as a result prices of the chips were a fifth of their level a year ago.

Chipmakers and large-lot users, like personal computer makers, had agreed a price of 950 to 1,050 yen per chip for the November shipment, down about four percent from the October shipment, the paper said.
The paper said customers had demanded price cuts following the falls in the spot-market price overseas.
At of the end of October, Japanese chipmakers said the price falls had already stopped.
